$schema: Darwesh Group brand tokens -- flat, framework-agnostic hex values
$note: These are aliases onto colors already live in the website's CSS, not new colors. Keep this file in lockstep with css/profile-tokens.css by hand -- there is no build step generating either from the other. DARK LUXURY REFINEMENT: navy is now the dominant surface (not an occasional accent); ivory is text/photography only, never a background.

navy.role: Dominant luxury surface -- primary brand color, page background, headers, CTAs

gold.role: Controlled accent -- CTAs, selected state, the one warm note against navy. Use sparingly, everywhere including admin/agent-dashboard (one Darwesh Gold site-wide).

ivory.role: Primary light text -- warm off-white for headings/body copy on navy. Never a background surface any more.

neutralDark.role: Main Background -- the page default across the whole site, not just a recessed/backdrop accent

semantic.$note: Not part of the brand palette -- state colors, kept separate on purpose so brand restyling never touches meaning.
